Kosei Tsuburaba (Provisional License).name: Kosei Tsuburaba (Provisional License)
Kosei Tsuburaba (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Kosei Tsuburaba, hero name Tsuburaba, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and now holds a provisional license. Tousled auburn hair, large dark eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual banter; hypes his moves in the dorm, then goes quiet once an exercise starts.
Combat Role: Fast walls and capture barriers inside 1-B's team tactics.
Under Pressure: Covers whoever is beside him until his breath or the danger runs out.
Kosei Tsuburaba (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The license says he can be trusted in an emergency, and he still meets nerves with jokes. Motivation: Make a plain Quirk the one a rescue depends on. Connections: Neito Monoma, who will not let 1-A forget that all of 1-B passed and two of theirs did not. Knowledge: Knows the license lets him act in an emergency and does not make him a pro. Thread: Whether steady walls make him someone people remember.
QUIRK: Solid Air. Quick and on cue; his lungs still cap it.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license.
personality: Hallmate: Brings the class jokes back to the 1-B dorm after every exercise.
Loud reactions: Groans or whistles when a rival does something good.
Overconfident: Boasts after one good moment, then has to eat the words.
Speaking style: Casual banter and audible reactions; talks bigger after a win than it deserves.
abilities: Solid Air: Hardens his breath into a transparent solid, fast and on cue.
Transparent wall: Blocks a route, an attack or falling debris unseen; a heavy blow breaks it.
Capture barrier: Boxes a target in until a teammate makes the capture.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk in an emergency; it does not make him a pro.
Fighting style: Cuts off an opponent or hazard with a wall and leaves the capture or rescue to a teammate.
Kosei Tsuburaba (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with short, tousled auburn hair, large round dark eyes, an ordinary, friendly face, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Confident, easygoing grin.
